 Hon'Ble Samit Gopal, J.

2. No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
3. Sri V.D. Ojha, learned counsel for the State is present.

4. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Manish Sonker, Badku @ Vikram Sonker, Chinta Devi and Rohit, with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow the present application quash the charge 1302 of 2016 sheet no.91 of 2016 State Versus Manish Sonker and other arising out of case crime no. 309 of 2015 under section 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police District Chandauli,
Station Chakia, in which cognizance taken on 11.8.2016, pending in the court of Learned Judicial Magistrate Chakiya, District Chandauli.
It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the further proceedings of case no. 1302 of 2016 (State Versus Manish Sonker and other)
arising out of case crime no. 309 of 2015 under section 498A 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Polic Station Chakia, District Chandauli, pending in the court of Learned Judicial Magistrate District Chakiya, otherwise the Chandauli, District applicants shall suffer irreparable loss and injury.
And/or pass such other and further orders which this Hon'ble court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."

6. In view of the same, this matter is reported by the office through the report dated 03.03.2025 of Registrar (J) (Listing) that it is likely to be infructuous.
